title: Introduction to A Guide to the Project Management Body of Knowledge
coreMove: Use the Standard for principles; use the Guide for domains, tailoring, and assets; bring in PMIstandards+ when context needs practice support.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a sponsor trusts the old process grid while the team must learn performance-domain navigation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Napoleon faces two bad teaching maps and chooses the one that preserves truth over comfort

exampleSpecs.stakes: the team may treat PMIstandards+ as a replacement for the Guide instead of companion application support
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mariam and Severine separate the Standard, the Guide, and PMIstandards+ through a spare exchange

exampleSpecs.stakes: a missing familiar table may be mistaken for missing operational guidance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Abel expects the gap log to prove guidance was removed, then discovers the map changed

exampleSpecs.stakes: a short reply could imply that the digital platform replaces the Guide
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Marion and Scott land the complementary role of PMIstandards+ in compressed messages

exampleSpecs.stakes: a routine PDF search keeps pulling the reader back to a process-entry habit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Nathalie interrupts the search routine and restarts from the performance-domain list

exampleSpecs.stakes: the new map must become visible in ordinary preparation, not only in training talk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Scott's desk shows the old ITTO note losing authority beside a domain list
